jobs.title: Home office build
jobs.summary: Acoustic slat walls, four floating birch shelves on hidden steel braces, two built-in workstations, and a walk-in closet with wraparound cabinets, a counter and LED-lit shelving.

materials.item: Three ¾″ birch plywood sheets and one ½″ sheet
Picked up the laminate held from yesterday; bought the 4.5″ cabinet feet to cut down to 3″
Drywall screws and wall plates, cash
Six sheets of ¼″ white plywood, cash
Three drawer box systems and the wood lining
Black outlet covers and liquid nails

stops.what: Cabinet stock dropped off for cutting.
Plywood and cabinet part runs, then back to LG Panels for adjustments.
Drawer boxes built from the white plywood.

timeline.note: Floor protection goes down, slats are cut to 93 inches and the first panel is test-fitted. The first 56 wall panels come from MI.ELITE in Hialeah.

timeline.title: Set the edges
timeline.note: Crown molding sets the ceiling line and the baseboards get touched up. The test panel comes down.

timeline.title: Shelves cut in
timeline.note: The drywall is opened on both sides. Three steel braces per shelf fasten into studs and disappear inside the birch shelves.

Steel shelf braces fastened to studs

timeline.note: The east shelves are up, bringing the room to four. Shelves fabricated and picked up at Calvin’s Custom Cabinetry.

timeline.note: Slats go up across the side walls. Cabinet stock is dropped off at LG Panels for cutting.

timeline.note: Slat work continues across the side walls, with a supply run to IMECA for cabinet feet.

timeline.note: The floor protection comes off and the crew assembles the cabinet boxes.

timeline.title: Inside the walk-in closet
timeline.note: Base cabinets line three sides under a U-shaped counter, with open shelves above and a soffit over the top. Short slats are cut to fit between counter and soffit.

tasks.t: Closet base cabinets set on three walls
Short slats fitted between counter and soffit

timeline.title: Around the window
timeline.note: Bare areas of the window wall are filled in with slats.

timeline.title: Fan and drawer boxes
timeline.note: A ceiling fan replaces the old ceiling cap. Drawer boxes are built at the carpenter’s shop from the white plywood.

tasks.t: Drawer boxes built at the carpenter’s shop

timeline.title: Two workstations
timeline.note: Each desktop bridges two cabinet pedestals, leaving knee space in the middle. Drawer systems and panels are picked up.

timeline.note: Drawer fronts and bar pulls finish the desks. Cabinet doors are picked up, paid ahead.

tasks.t: Drawer fronts and bar pulls installed

timeline.note: LED strips under the closet shelves wash light down the slats. The base cabinets get fitted doors and matching pulls.

tasks.t: Closet cabinet doors and pulls fitted

timeline.title: The last pieces
timeline.note: The last slats go under the desk. White blinds slide into the window recess and the full room comes into view.

tasks.t: Last slats fitted under the desk
